widgets_values: The same adult person from the reference video speaks naturally in precise synchronization with the supplied audio. Preserve the reference identity, age, face shape, hairstyle, clothing, body position, framing, background, lighting, and original camera movement as closely as possible. Subtle natural articulation with coordinated lips and jaw, relaxed expression, realistic skin and teeth. Follow the motion of the source video. No new gestures, no exaggerated expressions, no camera changes. Continuous realistic footage.

workflow_manifest.platform_evidence: Public RunningHub V2V examples; no claim that every account/environment has matching versions.
known_limits: User cloud node/model versions unverified; local model filenames can differ.
No pixel-exact preservation or automatic mouth-only masks.
Source still loaded/encoded as a full clip; outputs accumulate in RAM.
TTS voice identity is not recovered from silent video; 2048 generation-token cap remains.
No support guarantee for multiple faces, occlusion, rapid cuts, or severely blurred tiny faces.
Frames can differ by less than one frame from the audio endpoint because of floor rounding.
Sparse source references are a quality experiment and may cause boundary changes; fixed first-frame comparison is documented.
The only verified added weight is publicly listed, not confirmed downloaded in this account.
Nonblocking prefetch and disabling offload require memory-headroom checks.
Lower text CFG changes/weakens negative-prompt guidance; no claim of identical conditioning.
No universal wall-clock speed multiplier or improved-quality guarantee.
workflow_manifest.configuration_status: experimental adaptation of verified node capabilities, not a cloud-tested preset or certified quality improvement
